description: This file defines the 'Column' interface for representing table columns in Spark SQL connector, including static factory methods and property accessors.

classes.name: Column
classes.description: An interface representing a table column with properties like name, data type, nullability, default value, generation expression, identity specification, and metadata.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Static factory methods to create Column instances with various property configurations.

methods.name: name
methods.description: Returns the name of the column.

methods.name: dataType
methods.description: Returns the data type of the column.

methods.name: nullable
methods.description: Indicates if the column may contain null values.

methods.name: comment
methods.description: Returns the comment associated with the column, if any.

methods.name: defaultValue
methods.description: Returns the default value of the column, if any.

methods.name: generationExpression
methods.description: Returns the generation expression for the column, if any.

methods.name: identityColumnSpec
methods.description: Returns the identity column specification, if any.

methods.name: metadataInJSON
methods.description: Returns the column's metadata in JSON format.
